home.explore.title: What’s on your plate?

home.story.title: Three colours. One water story.

home.card.green.title: Rain, held by the soil
home.card.green.body: Rainwater stored in soil and used by crops as they grow.
home.card.blue.title: Rivers, lakes & aquifers
home.card.blue.body: Surface and groundwater supplied through irrigation.
home.card.grey.title: Keeping water clean

home.how.step2body: Add quantity, location and production method.

home.insight.title: Maharashtra at a glance
home.insight.body: Regional conditions help give every estimate meaningful context.
footer.disclaimer: Demo estimates vary with location, season, irrigation, yield and farming practice. They are not direct physical measurements.
scan.sub: The camera identifies your product; contextual data powers the estimate.
scan.tip1body: Keep other objects outside the frame.
scan.tip3body: Fill most of the scanning frame.
scan.supported: Supported: cereals, pulses, vegetables, fruits and major cash crops.
phone.pushFail: The computer could not read that.
phone.tooSmall: That image is too small to read. Move closer and try again.
phone.barcodeFail: Could not open the camera for barcodes. Use Photo instead.
phone.regenerate: Generate a new code on the computer and scan it again.
phone.sentBody: The result is on the laptop screen.
profile.title: Your water story
camera.insecure: The camera needs a secure connection. Open the site over https:// (or on localhost) and it will work.
camera.unsupported: This browser cannot open a camera. Upload a photo instead.
camera.denied: Camera permission was blocked. Allow it in the address bar, or upload a photo.
camera.none: No camera available on this device. Upload a photo instead.
camera.hintLive: Place one product inside the frame, then tap the shutter
camera.hintOff: Turn the camera on, or upload a photo
confirm.estimatedBody: Ingredient amounts are inferred from their order on the packet, which is listed by descending weight. Treat this as an estimate.
bridge.ctaHint: Better camera — the result appears here
bridge.title: Take a photo with your phone
bridge.hostEdit: Phone address (edit if your laptop's IP changed):
bridge.hostNeeded: This page is open on localhost, which your phone cannot reach. Enter your laptop's address (ipconfig → IPv4):
result.swapSaves: saves about {litres} L of irrigation water at this portion.
season.note: Season changes the split between rainfall and irrigation, not the published total. Kharif crops take much of their water from the monsoon; rabi and summer crops lean on irrigation instead.
compare.title: Compare in context
compare.rankedBy: Ranked by irrigation water, not by total.
compare.switching: Switching from {from} to {to} saves about {litres} L of irrigation water at this portion.
compare.axisNote: Bars show green (rainfall), blue (irrigation) and grey (pollution dilution) on one shared axis. A lower total does not automatically make a product nutritionally, culturally or economically better.
barcode.why: A barcode gives us the manufacturer's own ingredient list, so the estimate rests on the label rather than on a guess.
barcode.typeNumber: Or type the number under the bars
barcode.noDetector: This browser cannot read barcodes from the camera. Type the number instead.
barcode.denied: Camera permission denied. Type the number off the packet instead.
explore.title: Explore water stories
result.equivalent: That is about {days} days of one person's household water.
status.explain.safe: Groundwater here is drawn within safe limits.
status.explain.semi_critical: Groundwater here is under early pressure.
status.explain.critical: Groundwater here is close to its limit.
status.explain.over_exploited: More groundwater is drawn here than is replenished.
confidence.explain.medium: National average data was used for some ingredients.
confidence.explain.low: Some ingredients fell back to a category average.
swap.millet: Switching {from} for {to} uses about {times}× less irrigation water.
swap.meat: Switching {from} for {to} uses about {times}× less irrigation water.
swap.protein: A plant protein like {to} uses about {times}× less irrigation water than {from}.
swap.oilseed: {to} needs about {times}× less irrigation water than {from}.
swap.beverage: {to} needs about {times}× less irrigation water than {from}.
scan.title: Scan an agricultural product
scan.ready: Place one product inside the frame
scan.notConfigured: Camera identification is not configured. Search by name instead.
scan.failed: Could not identify that image. Try again, or search by name.
disclaimer: This is a modelled estimate, not a direct measurement. Actual water use varies by farm, season, soil and irrigation.
result.eq.householdDays: About {count} days of one person's household water
result.eq.drinkingDays: About {count} days of drinking water for one person
scan.quota: The free daily image limit has been used up. Search by name or scan a barcode instead — both still work.
vision.none.title: Nothing recognised
vision.none.body: No agricultural product was identified in that photo. Move closer, use one product at a time, or search by name.
vision.refused.title: Nothing recognised
vision.refused.body: The model would not name anything in that photo rather than guess. Try better light and a single product, or search by name.
vision.unreadable.title: Photo unreadable
vision.unreadable.body: That image could not be read. Retake it, or search by name.
vision.quota.title: Daily photo limit reached
vision.quota.body: The image recognition quota is used up for today. Barcode scanning and search still work.
vision.timeout.title: Recognition timed out
vision.timeout.body: The model did not answer in time. Try again, or search by name.
vision.failed.title: Recognition failed
vision.failed.body: Something went wrong reading that photo. This says nothing about the product — try again, or search by name.
vision.not_configured.title: Camera recognition unavailable
vision.not_configured.body: No vision provider is configured on this build. Use the barcode scanner or search by name.
barcode.not_found.title: Barcode not in the database
barcode.not_found.body: Open Food Facts has no entry for this barcode. Search for the product by name instead.
barcode.no_ingredients.title: No ingredient list
barcode.no_ingredients.body: Open Food Facts has this product but nobody has added its ingredients, so there is nothing to cost. Search by name instead.
barcode.rate_limited.title: Lookup throttled
barcode.rate_limited.body: Open Food Facts is rate-limiting us. Wait a minute and scan again — this says nothing about the product.
barcode.upstream_error.title: Lookup failed
barcode.upstream_error.body: We could not reach Open Food Facts. This says nothing about the product — try again in a moment.
barcode.timeout.title: Lookup timed out
barcode.timeout.body: Open Food Facts did not answer in time. Try again, or search by name.
barcode.offline.title: No connection
barcode.offline.body: Barcode lookup needs the internet. Search by name still works.
map.title: Where this water came from
map.subtitle: The states that produced this number, shaded by groundwater status
map.note: Colour is groundwater status only. Border weight shows share of supply. Figures are state averages; where CGWB publishes a category rather than a percentage, the band is shown.
water.title: City water clock
water.heading: What your city has stored
water.sub: Your plate draws on the same water these reservoirs hold.
water.capacity: {stored} ML stored of {total} ML total capacity
community.title: Community level
community.heading: What {region} has been scanning
community.inflowNote: Virtual water inflow is the share embedded in produce grown outside this region — water the region consumes but never sees. Region only; no personal data is recorded.
explore.count: {count} products, every figure computed from the same engine
result.bandNote: CGWB publishes the category for this state, not a percentage. The band is shown rather than a decimal we cannot cite.
vision.demo_offline.title: Demo mode — camera off
vision.demo_offline.body: Demo mode makes no network calls, and photo recognition needs one. Search by name or scan a barcode — both work fully offline.
auth.name: Your name
auth.pinHint: 4–6 digits. This only stops a casual look on a shared device — never type a password you use elsewhere.
auth.localOnly: Saved on this device only. Nothing is uploaded.
auth.noHistory: Nothing yet — look up a product and it will appear here.
auth.optional: Optional — everything works without signing in.
auth.err.name: Please enter a name of at least 2 characters.
auth.err.pin: A PIN must be 4 to 6 digits.
auth.err.exists: A profile with that name already exists on this device.
auth.err.invalid: That name or PIN is not correct.
learn.tryRice: Try it in the calculator — rice →
learn.englishNote: This lesson is in English for now — translations are being reviewed by a native speaker.
chat.greeting: Namaste! Ask me about any crop's water, a state's groundwater, or how the app works.
chat.generalLabel: General information — not from our dataset
chat.unavailable: General questions need the AI service, which is unreachable right now. Questions about our data still work.
chat.figureRedirect: That needs an exact figure, and exact figures come only from our database. Search for it in the app and you will get the cited number.
chat.limit: That is the limit for this session — explore the app for more.
chat.sugg.gw: What is the groundwater level in Punjab?
chat.sugg.crop: How much water does rice need?
chat.tmpl.crop: {name}: about {green} L rain, {blue} L irrigation and {grey} L dilution per kilogram — {total} L in total (Mekonnen & Hoekstra 2011).
chat.tmpl.compareNote: The irrigation figure is the one that competes with groundwater.
chat.tmpl.worst: {state} is the most stressed: {pct}% of groundwater extracted — {category} (CGWB).
chat.tmpl.result: {name}: {total} L for this serving — {green} L rain, {blue} L irrigation, {grey} L dilution. Water stress score {score}/100.
chat.tmpl.partial: No data for: {missing} — outside our dataset.
result.excludedNote: {ingredients} excluded — animal water footprints are not in our source data.
vision.out_of_scope.title: Outside our scope
vision.out_of_scope.body: We can identify it, but this tool covers agricultural products only — crops, dishes and foods made from them.
